description:
Parse tab-separated values into JSON. First row is treated as header unless header=false.

Returns: JSON array of row objects derived from the TSV header row.
Example input: {"text":"name\tage\nAda\t36\nGrace\t85"}
On error, includes hint: `text` must use real tab (\t) separators, not multiple spaces.
name: tsv_parse
title: TSV parser
